About.title: About
About.body: Full-stack developer finishing a B.S. in Information Systems and Technologies (CTIS) at Bilkent University. Most of what I know comes from internships, coursework, and personal projects, and I pick up new tools as projects need them. Looking for a team to build useful things with.

points: Developed a native (Google-independent) Speech-to-Text application for Android in Android Studio.
Worked on Microsoft SQL database systems.
Built a physiotherapy appointment web application with ASP.NET Core 6.0 in Visual Studio 2022.
Built an AI-powered "assembly engine" that turns a business description into an executable, custom ERP.
